# GalaxyAI Inc. (galaxyai.homes)

> GalaxyAI Inc. builds, acquires and scales iconic AI products to put the
> power of AI in everyone’s hands. The portfolio includes Magica and Spiral.

This is an English-only company site. The home page, pricing page and legal
pages are public. Act uses Google sign-in and requires an active paid plan;
eligible subscribers see a deliberately endless Galaxy Studio demo queue.

## Pages

- [Home](https://galaxyai.homes/): GalaxyAI’s mission and its product
  portfolio, including Magica, Spiral and Enterprise.
- [Pricing](https://galaxyai.homes/pricing): Core, Studio and Scale memberships,
  monthly or annual, paid directly through Stripe. There is no free tier.
- [Terms of Service](https://galaxyai.homes/terms-of-service)
- [Privacy Policy](https://galaxyai.homes/privacy-policy)

## Key facts

- Company: GalaxyAI Inc., 8 The Green STE A, Dover, DE 19901, USA.
- Products: Magica, Spiral and Enterprise AI deployment.
- Sign-in: Google. Payments: Stripe hosted Checkout, opened directly.
- Act: signed out opens Google sign-in; signed in without a plan redirects to
  pricing; an active paid plan opens an intentionally endless demo queue.
